urlText: L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines weeknight full closures due to maintenance
content:
From Monday 21 to Wednesday 23 July, nightly from 9pm to 1am, L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines light rail services will not run due to planned trackwork and maintenance works.
 
During this time, use alternative transport including:
  • Replacement bus services or regular bus services between Central Chalmers Street and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford,
  • Train services, regular bus services or walking if able to, between Circular Quay and Central Chalmers Street.
Replacement bus services:
  • Replacement bus services will run every 10 to 15 minutes from 9pm to 1am nightly. These times may vary depending on road traffic.
  • Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations:
    • Surry Hills (towards Central and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford) - Use the alternative stop at Central Chalmers Street (approx. 8 minute walk),
    • Wansey Road (towards Central) - Use the alternative stop at Royal Randwick (approx. 12 minute walk),
    • UNSW High Street (towards Central and Randwick) - Use the alternative stop at Randwick (approx. 10 minute walk).
  • Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, please wait for the next service.
  • See the news story for more detailed service information.
  • Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.

urlText: Sydney Olympic Park bus diversions for Wallabies v The British & Irish Lions
content:
From 3am Friday 1 August to 3am Sunday 3 August, routes 525 and 526 services will be diverting while roads are closed in Sydney Olympic Park for the Wallabies v The British & Irish Lions match. 
 
Services in both directions will be diverting via Edwin Flack Avenue, Sarah Durack Avenue and Australia Avenue, and will miss stops on Dawn Fraser Avenue and Park Street. Catch these services from the stop on Park Street at Olympic Park train station or other alternative stop locations on Edwin Flack Avenue.  
 
Allow extra time and check signs at stops for alternate stop locations. Visit the Wallabies v The Lions event page for more details.
